sources.title: Botswana Stock Exchange, Market Holidays: Mark your calendar 2026 (the Government’s notice under section 2 of the Public Holidays Act)
sources.said: In pursuance of the provisions of section 2 of the Public Holiday Act, notice is hereby given that public holidays will be observed on the following days of the year 2026: NEW YEAR’S DAY Thursday 1st January, 2026 PUBLIC HOLIDAY Friday 2nd January, 2026 GOOD FRIDAY Friday 3rd April, 2026 PUBLIC HOLIDAY Saturday 4th April, 2026 EASTER MONDAY Monday 6th April 2026 LABOUR DAY Friday 1st May, 2026 ASCENSION DAY Thursday 14th May, 2026 PUBLIC HOLIDAY Friday 15th May, 2026 SIR SERETSE KHAMA DAY Wednesday 1st July, 2026 PRESIDENT’S DAY Monday 20th July, 2026 PUBLIC HOLIDAY Tuesday 21st July, 2026 BOTSWANA DAY Wednesday 30th September, 2026 PUBLIC HOLIDAY Thursday 1st October, 2026 CHRISTMAS DAY Friday 25th December, 2026 BOXING DAY Saturday 26th December, 2026

sources.title: Government of Botswana, Public Holidays (read through the web fetcher: the site’s certificate has expired, which curl refuses)
sources.said: New Year’s Day January 01 2026; Good Friday April 03 2026; Public Holiday April 04 2026; Easter Monday April 06 2026; Labour Day May 01 2026; Ascension Day May 14 2026; Sir Seretse Khama Day July 01 2026; President’s Day July 20 2026; Public Holiday July 21 2026; Botswana Day September 30 2026; Public Holiday October 01 2026; Christmas Day December 25 2026; Boxing Day December 26 2026. (The page omits 2 January and the 15 May the Government later declared; the notice the Stock Exchange reproduces has both.)

sources.title: Botswana Stock Exchange, Public Notice: Friday 15 May 2026 declared public holiday (12 May 2026)
sources.said: The public is hereby informed that the Government of the Republic of Botswana has declared Friday, 15 May 2026, a public holiday.

sources.title: Botswana Stock Exchange, Public Notice: 28 December 2021 and 4 January 2022 declared public holidays (the Sunday rule in practice: Sunday 26 December 2021 and Sunday 2 January 2022 were kept on the Mondays without a declaration)
sources.said: 28th December, 2021 and 04th January, 2022 will be non-trading days at the Botswana Stock Exchange (BSE) as they have been declared public holidays by the Government of the Republic of Botswana.

sources.title: Botswana Stock Exchange, Circular: Monday 3rd July 2023 to be observed as a public holiday (29 June 2023): a Saturday holiday’s Monday comes by the Government’s declaration
sources.said: it is in receipt of a Circular Savingram from the Botswana Government (refer to Annexure), which indicates that Monday 3rd July 2023 will be observed as a Public Holiday since 1st July is a paid Public Holiday in Botswana.
